definitions.unit: VND billion. Costs are negative, as reported.
definitions.brokerage_net: rev_brokerage + cost_brokerage: brokerage result after its direct cost, before overheads
definitions.loans_to_equity_pct: loans / equity; the regulatory ceiling on margin lending is 200% of equity
definitions.lending_yield_pct: rev_lending x 4 / average of opening and closing loans
definitions.funding_cost: -interest_expense - cost_provision_and_loan_funding - rise in loan_allowance. Strips the provision charge out of template line 24, approximated by the change in the balance-sheet allowance; write-offs would make this overstate funding cost
definitions.funding_cost_pct: funding_cost x 4 / average of opening and closing debt, debt = short_term_borrowing + bonds_short + bonds_long
definitions.customer_cash_trading: off-balance-sheet: investors' cash held for securities trading
definitions.customer_securities_vsd: off-balance-sheet: investors' listed securities deposited at VSDC through DNSE
